properties.name: Covert Tradecraft
properties.description: Infiltration, surveillance, disguise and deception carried out under cover.

properties.name: Close Combat
properties.description: Formidable in hand-to-hand fighting and improvised brawling.

properties.name: Issued Gadgetry
properties.description: Uses specialised equipment supplied by a state agency and adapts it on the fly.

properties.name: Suave Composure
properties.description: Charming and unflappable under danger; uses charm to draw out information.

properties.name: Licensed Agent
properties.description: Acts under state authority and orders, deniable and expendable to the agency.

properties.name: Human Limits
properties.description: Injury, exhaustion, poison and fear all apply; no powers beyond human skill.

visual_traits.descriptor: tall, athletic, broad-shouldered frame with an easy, upright carriage
angular, clean-shaven face with cool blue-grey eyes and a dry half-smile
a tailored dark suit, white shirt and narrow dark tie
charcoal, midnight blue and crisp white
a compact pistol in a shoulder holster
a small gadget slipping into the palm, a tiny light blinking on its face

exclusion_candidates.item: the agency, its codes and its chain of command
